sn56.55:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso mahāpathaviyā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhipeyya || || 3.
sn56.55:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yā vā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī ti || ||
sn56.55:1.4: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idam mahāpathavī || appamattikā sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā
sn56.55:1.5: saṅkham pi na upenti upanidham pi na upenti || pe || mahāpathavim upanidhāya sattakolaṭṭhimattiyo guḷikā upanikkhittā || || 4--5.
sn56.55:1.6: Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa || so yeva peyyālo ||
